top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at Granfondo Belgium. Practice on ardennes hilly loops: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 85 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Belgium's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
80ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Granfondo Belgium, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Belgium. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 85, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
6,890ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
6,890ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Granfondo Belgium. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on ardennes hilly loops can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 85 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 6,890ft of climbing on ardennes hilly loops does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Granfondo Belgium’s 85 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Granfondo Belgium rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on ardennes hilly loops to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 85 miles of ardennes hilly loops in Les Lacs de l'Eau d'Heure, Hainaut, Belgium.
